notes: Every s### and t### partitioned exactly once.

οἱ before a participle supplies the pronoun and nothing else (rule 32), the ASV writing two words, so *they* goes to the article and *that have served* to the participle; rule 90's one-word case does not arise.

ἐν πίστει τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ is rule 31's following-article case: the anarthrous noun takes the supplied *the*, the second article keeps only *which*, and the copula goes with ἐν because a prepositional phrase has no verb to carry it.
βαθμὸν … καλόν is wholly anarthrous, so the supplied determiner belongs to the noun under rule 58; Χριστῷ and Ἰησοῦ are split as separately recoverable names under rule 17.
